title: Insured Return of a Piece from the Bench
content:
# Desk Standing Rule: The Insured Return of a Piece from the Bench

## When a piece travels back insured

Where a customer of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service asks for a finished piece to be sent back rather than collected, sending a piece at the bench back to its owner insured is charged on the level's own insured shipping rate, and the charge is priced onto the work order as a postage line.

The charge for sending the piece back is worked out only after the work order carries a signed release naming the value the piece is held at.

## The effect on the order

From the moment the postage line lands, what the customer owes on the order rises by that amount and the piece is set to travel insured to the customer rather than be collected over the counter. The customer sees the postage line on their bench bill.

## Raising the postage line

The line is raised by the desk. The desk unlocks the workshop's own tool `charge_insured_shipping_16f801d8` and calls it. One call books a single insured-shipping line against the named work order under the insured shipping charge code, stamped with today's date and accounting period, written as a positive movement.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_order_id` | the bench work order record the postage line is charged to | an id, as returned by the work order lookup |
| `customer_id` | the customer profile the work order belongs to | an id, as returned by the customer profile lookup |
| `work_order_reference` | the reference the customer is given for the work order the postage line is raised against | WO- followed by six digits, for example WO-772140; upper case, no spaces, copied exactly as it stands on the work order |
| `shipping_amount` | the charge for sending the piece insured | a positive figure in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the cent |

### Return

A one-line confirmation naming the new priced line's reference number, the work order reference it was raised against and the amount charged in USD to two decimal places. A returned line naming the entry reference is the receipt that the postage charge now stands on the order.
